name: Checkpoint mid air jump: a ground jump from a respawn 64 u above the floor
techNote: A floor and a ledge (x 220-800, top y 290) with the finish box on it; the respawn point is 76 u above the floor under the start (a checkpoint that respawns the dot 64 u above standing, as the one at 13402, 3159 in the Courses 6-10 world does). Stand 5 ticks and quick restart (Movement.respawn: 12 u under the checkpoint, y 97.5, onGround set, Velocity 0, coyoteFrames kept: 6 from the ground). onGround holds while it falls and coyoteFrames counts down; jump with right on input 10, the last coyote tick (coyoteFrames 1): the full 805 ground jump from y 89.9, 56 u above standing, peaks at y 347.7 and lands on the ledge (finish on tick 42). `ground` (the same inputs, no restart) peaks at 291.8 and hits the ledge's face; `late` (the jump a tick after the coyote ran out) is no jump: the dot lands on the floor and walks into the face.

ghosts.label: Quick restart, jump on the last coyote tick
The same jump from the floor: into the face
A tick after the coyote ran out: no jump
